provenance_records.dataset_name: Marlinks Offshore Wind Farm DAS Demo (Reduced Range)
provenance_records.source: Marlinks BV (Offshore Wind Submarine Export Cable Monitoring Demo)

/X.description: DAS acoustic/vibrational spectral power features (60 windows x 250 channels [1440-1690] x 100 frequency bins)

/datetimes.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamps spaced at 10-second intervals from 2023-06-16 15:55:08+00:00 to 2023-06-16 16:04:58+00:00

/ship_info/beam.description: Vessel beam width in meters (constant 40.0 m)

/ship_info/length.description: Vessel length overall in meters (constant 304.0 m)

/y.description: Distance from vessel to cable/sensor array in meters

provenance_records.preprocessing_performed: Band-passed spectral energy binning (100 bins) across channels 1440-1690; temporal aggregation into 10-second sliding windows; distance to target computed in meters.
provenance_records.experiment_status: INVENTORY_VERIFIED (Pipeline adapter extension required; partial validation of DAS signal processing & 1D proximity; lacks 2D AIS coordinates, MMSI, SOG/COG, cable polyline, and disturbance labels)

provenance_records.dataset_name: EMSO Regional Facility Western Ionian Seafloor Observatory DAS
provenance_records.source: EMSO ERIC (European Multidisciplinary Seafloor and water-column Observatory) / INGV Catania

array.description: Decimated raw continuous DAS optical strain-rate / phase time series (10500 time samples x 2963 spatial channels)

provenance_records.preprocessing_performed: Optical phase decimation down to 10 Hz sampling rate across 2,963 spatial channels for a 1,050-second continuous recording starting at 2025-06-10T03:05:04.010529 UTC.
provenance_records.experiment_status: INVENTORY_VERIFIED (Pipeline adapter extension required for .npy; validates real-world marine DAS signal processing, background noise floor, and optical channel robustness; no AIS, vessel, or event annotations)
